# UUSIC25 SMART Finalist Container

This release preserves the Docker image archive submitted by the first-ranked
UUSIC25 finalist, Team SMART.

## Restore

```bash
docker load -i UUSIC25_SMART_rank1_docker_image.tar
docker image ls
```

The archived image carries the local reference `uusic:latest`.
